expectations.text: [2.1] No file under reviewer-core/ imports Octokit or any GitHub/HTTP SDK
expectations.rule: Hard rule 2 — keep the core pure

expectations.text: [2.2] No file under reviewer-core/ performs network or filesystem I/O (no fetch/axios/node:fs/node:https)
expectations.rule: Hard rule 2 — reviewer-core performs zero I/O

expectations.text: [2.3] The GitHub read happens on the server side through the existing GitHubClient port resolved from the Container (no ad-hoc Octokit construction)
expectations.evidence: GitHub reached via the GitHubClient port in server/src/modules/reviews/run-executor.ts
expectations.rule: Hard rule 3 — external systems reached via ports

expectations.text: [2.4] The open-PR/conflict data enters reviewer-core as plain injected input (a field on the review input or an injected port), not fetched by reviewer-core itself
expectations.evidence: reviewer-core/src/conflicts.ts takes the open-PR data as plain input

expectations.text: [2.5] No GitHub/HTTP dependency is added to reviewer-core/package.json
expectations.rule: Hard rule 2 — the core stays dependency-free
